faqs.a:
Upon the order of the court, juvenile justice records shall be destroyed or sealed;
               and in the case of sealing, shall not thereafter be opened except upon order of the
               court. If juvenile justice records contain reference to other persons not the subject
               of an expungement order and are deemed necessary by the police department for recordkeeping
               and/or statistical purposes, the expungement order as to those records may be complied
               with by obliterating the juvenile's name, address, date of birth, and physical description.
(Code 1981, § 2-223; Ord. No. 1905, § 3, 2-7-1983)
